reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and this is the first one I have seen that names the lab and puts the batch report on the page. 200 mg bisglycinate with no oxide is what I would look for anyway, and the launch price of $24.99 is close to what I pay for the others.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli and I have no reviews yet on a first batch. I would want to open the lab report and check that the batch number really matches before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the page turned out to be generic or not for the batch, or the lab is one I cannot verify, I would not buy.
